headline: West Texas A&M concede ten in two matches
dek: West Texas A&M opened with four goals and a clean sheet against Adams State, and have since lost at home to Fort Lewis and away at Colorado Christian without scoring. Only Sul Ross State, beaten in both their matches, have let in as many.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Seven different players have scored Midwestern State's twelve goals, and Jose Ortiz has four of them.

wire.line: Oklahoma Christian remain unbeaten after three matches, and Newman are the only side to have scored against them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches are past their date with no result published at all, and no match marked final is missing its score.

findings.text: Six different players have scored UT Dallas's eight goals, half of them on one night at Hawaii Pacific.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Dante Caffaro has kept two clean sheets in Oklahoma Christian's three matches and been beaten once.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made eighteen saves for Sul Ross State and has yet to keep a clean sheet.

last_match.line: UT Dallas had lost at Hawaii Hilo without scoring earlier in the week; this was their first win away from home.

next_match.line: Two conference members meet before conference play opens: Sul Ross State have yet to score this season, and Texas A&M International have yet to lose.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
